units.source_text: 他近日常常来此，希图或有机缘与云居雁相见。

en.t: Recently he had often come here, hoping that some chance might let him meet Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 他看见门前停着内大臣的车子，便内心羞怯，悄悄地钻进自己房间里去了。

en.t: When he saw the Minister of the Interior's carriage stopped before the gate, he felt shy and slipped quietly into his own room.

units.source_text: 内大臣的公子左少将、少纳言、兵卫佐、侍从、大夫等，也聚集在这里。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior's sons, including the Left Lesser Captain, the Lesser Counselor, the Assistant Captain of the Guards, the Chamberlain, and the Senior Secretary, had also gathered here.

units.source_text: 但太君不许他们进入帘内。

en.t: But the Grand Lady would not allow them to come inside the curtains.

units.source_text: 内大臣的兄弟左卫门督与权中纳言等，虽非太君所生，但他们还是遵守前太政大臣在世之时的规矩，照旧常来参谒太君，竭尽孝敬。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior's brothers, such as the Captain of the Left Gate Guards and the Provisional Middle Counselor, were not born to the Grand Lady, but they still observed the customs from the late Chancellor's lifetime, continued to visit her as before, and showed her every filial respect.

units.source_text: 他们的儿子也来此，但品貌都赶不上夕雾。

en.t: Their sons came here as well, but in character and appearance none could compare with Yugiri.

units.source_text: 太君对夕雾比谁都疼爱。

en.t: The Grand Lady loved Yugiri more dearly than anyone else.

units.source_text: 自从夕雾迁居东院之后，只有这云居雁是太君身边的宝贝。

en.t: Since Yugiri had moved to the Eastern Residence, only Kumoi no Kari remained as the treasure at the Grand Lady's side.

units.source_text: 太君悉心教养她，时刻不离地抚爱她。

en.t: The Grand Lady had raised her with devoted care and cherished her without letting her leave her side for even a moment.

units.source_text: 如今将被内大臣夺去，太君心中异常悲伤。

en.t: Now that she was about to be taken away by the Minister of the Interior, the Grand Lady was deeply grieved.

units.source_text: 内大臣说：“此刻我要进宫，傍晚来迎接她。”

en.t: The Minister of the Interior said, "I must go to the palace now; I will come to fetch her in the evening."
With that, he took his leave and departed.
